about: What `roc docs package/main.roc` may show, checked by scripts/all_tests.py (step `docs`). `public` lists the modules and items callers are meant to use; each must appear. `known_internal` lists internal helpers that leak into the generated docs today because they are associated items of `Font`; while any of them appears the step reports a KNOWN failure (accepted only with --allow-known). Any item in neither list fails the step, and an entry in `known_internal` that no longer appears fails it too, so the list can only shrink. When an item becomes public on purpose, move it to `public` in the same change.
